More about FarmTheory Made with AI
Edit
Farm Theory operates in the agricultural and food delivery market, focusing on reducing food waste and increasing farmer incomes by delivering 'ugly' or imperfect produce directly from farms to consumers.
The company serves environmentally conscious consumers who are willing to purchase produce that may not meet traditional aesthetic standards but is perfectly edible. Farm Theory's business model revolves around an efficient, tech-enabled supply chain that connects farmers with consumers through a network of distribution hubs.
This model allows the company to minimize waste and offer fresh produce at competitive prices. Revenue is generated through the sale of these products, leveraging the cost savings from reduced waste and direct sourcing.
The company also benefits farmers by providing them with an additional revenue stream for produce that would otherwise be discarded.
